description:
Jung Woo-yeon, who was left with deep trauma from his first love, now only engages in casual relationships through dating apps as an adult. One night, while spending time with yet another stranger, a new match notification appears on his phone.
The match is none other than his first boyfriend, Choi Han-gyeol—the man who toyed with him and discarded him without mercy.

[“How could I sleep when a pretty girl like you’s talking to me? lol”]

Seeing Han-gyeol act as if he doesn’t remember him, Woo-yeon becomes consumed by the urge to ruin him completely.
When Woo-yeon suggests meeting offline, Han-gyeol agrees without hesitation. The two wait for the next day, each harboring very different intentions.

[Original Webtoon](https://bomtoon.com/detail/handle1su)
